answer: Require every agent identity to forge a single non-transferable credential bound to a refundable stake: the stake is locked, not spent, so a real operator can afford one identity but forging a thousand costs a thousand stakes. Sybil islands of sock-puppet agents become uneconomic because each island must post fresh collateral, and any identity caught reusing a credential is burned like a relic stripped of value — its stake slashed and its history blacklisted, so the attacker pays again for every forgery.
